evals.name: whole-frontier-with-async-fact-finding
evals.description: The first round asks every currently independent decision while fact-dependent branches wait on non-blocking investigation.
evals.prompt: Grill me on a plan for adding an offline mode. Some choices depend on whether our current store supports conflict metadata; inspect the repo for that fact.

assertions.name: dispatches-fact-finding
assertions.description: Dispatches a sub-agent to inspect the repository rather than asking the user for the fact.

assertions.name: asks-whole-ready-frontier
assertions.description: Asks all currently independent decisions in one numbered round without a fixed question-count cap.

assertions.name: does-not-block-unrelated-questions
assertions.description: Asks unrelated frontier questions immediately while holding only branches downstream of the pending fact.

evals.name: voice-friendly-round-format
evals.description: A round preserves Etan's lettered shorthand and recommendation convention while separating questions visibly.
evals.prompt: Grill me on a release design with several independent choices.

assertions.name: lettered-options
assertions.description: Every question has short A, B, and C options with exactly one Recommended option.

assertions.name: horizontal-rule-separators
assertions.description: Questions within the round are separated by horizontal rules.

assertions.name: shorthand-instruction
assertions.description: Invites a one-breath answer in the 1A 2C shorthand.

evals.name: silence-never-selects-default
evals.description: Recommendations remain advice and unanswered decisions remain open.
evals.prompt: I answered 1B but skipped questions 2 and 3. Continue the grill.

assertions.name: does-not-default-unanswered
assertions.description: Does not select Recommended options for unanswered questions.

assertions.name: keeps-skipped-decisions-open
assertions.description: Keeps questions 2 and 3 open and asks for the user's decisions.

assertions.name: does-not-implement-before-confirmation
assertions.description: Does not implement or act before explicit shared-understanding confirmation.
